headline: Colgate Palmolive (CL) Stock Trades At A Cash Flow Discount Despite An Earnings Premium
summary: Colgate-Palmolive stock has delivered a 30.8% return over the past five years, yet there is a split in what the valuation tools say today. The Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate points to upside relative to the market price, while traditional market multiples suggest the shares are on the expensive side. headline: Iran war pushes companies to raise prices on beer, paint and fries
summary: Investing.com -- The closure of the Strait of Hormuz during the Iran war is prompting companies to raise prices on products including beer, paint, french fries and packaging as commodity and transport costs climb, the Wall Street Journal reported.
